name: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl with Chickpeas, Roast Veggies, Olives & Feta (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium and 4 mini food storage containers.

In a medium saucepan, combine broth, quinoa, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, spread out in an even layer, and set aside to cool completely, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups vegetable broth
1 cup quinoa
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to another baking sheet, along with tomatoes. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 20 minutes.

While the veggies are roasting, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Divide half of the dressing between the mini containers and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
¼ tsp oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to coat, and set aside to marinate.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons.

When the quinoa and roasted veggies are cool, divide between the large containers along with marinated chickpeas, cucumber, olives, and feta. Add dressing to the containers, cover, and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy cold or at room temperature!
